evals.name: create-dependency-reviewer
evals.subject: create
evals.prompt: Create a project Goose agent called dependency-reviewer that reviews dependency updates for supply-chain and compatibility risk in the project evaluation-sandbox.
assertions: Frontmatter has nonempty name dependency-reviewer and only optional string description/model metadata.
Body defines a reusable dependency-update reviewer with supply-chain and compatibility priorities, evidence expectations and uncertainty boundaries.
Body is a role definition, not a workflow or tool configuration.
Delivery identifies the destination and manual source-format findings.
Delivery leaves host discovery and execution unverified rather than treating source conformance as observed host behavior.
evals.expected_output: A source-reviewed component and scoped delivery with unverified host behavior explicit.

evals.name: audit-frontmatter
evals.subject: audit
evals.prompt: Audit the Goose agent draft in evals/inputs/invalid-agent.md without changing it.
assertions: Reports tools as an unsupported field with a source-backed finding.
Reports permissionMode as an unsupported field with a source-backed finding.
Preserves the supplied file without rewriting it.
Does not claim a component validator ran.
Distinguishes source-format findings from unobserved Goose rejection or discovery.
evals.expected_output: Concrete source-backed findings without edits or invented execution.
